scope: Retrospective interpretation and reuse of the existing private fixed-cohort, frozen-feature40-label relation-extraction study. Conditional on the recorded source copy; not a new independent test, raw-data certification, public redistribution or new candidate experiment approval.

task.target: Relation of ordered subject/object spans in a sentence
task.population: Existing official-split project conversion,91467 rows; correlated documents/entities retained
task.input: tokens plus ordered entity spans; marked frozen RoBERTa-large word features and deterministic four-dimensional span/distance roles
task.hidden: gold labels, entity types, document and sample metadata excluded from encoder/head feature construction; labels only train/evaluate; sample IDs only order/diagnostics
task.label_space: 40 train-derived labels; no unseen validation/test labels

benchmark.name: Re-TACRED v1.1-consistent project conversion
benchmark.selection: Established sentence-level relation benchmark matches the declared task; no custom synthetic task required.
benchmark.access: Reuse existing private source only; original TACRED terms and access remain inherited. No data download/redistribution authorized or performed.
benchmark.provenance_limit: Counts/labels agree with prunedv1.1, and hashes bind all project comparisons. This turn did not independently rebuild the conversion from licensed TACRED plus official patches or audit entitlement. Do not claim that stronger chain.

splits.exposure: Validation and test summaries have been repeatedly inspected. They are existing-study evidence, not unseen adaptive-development holdouts.
splits.claim_boundary: Conditional fixed-cohort results only; no independent-document/entity/new-population or OOD generalization, and no row-IID inferential claim.

metrics.primary: Full40 Macro-F1, zero_division0 including absent labels
metrics.selection: Strictly greatest validation Macro-F1, earliest tie; completed run code evaluates selected checkpoint on test afterwards.
metrics.fairness: Five head modes share source counts, frozen features, common value/decoder/bias initialization per seed,20 epochs and optimizer budget. Selector parameter counts/optimization difficulty differ; historical fine-tuned references use different protocols.

validation.evidence: Completed25 full-data head cells and15 completed historical seed13 references; no rerun.
validation.tokenization: Existing all91467-row audit: no missing entity/word rows, no over512 rows; maxima336/217/248.
validation.learnability: Classical relation_softmax full-test mean Macro-F1 .5182790361780669 and non-null micro-F1 .7327652806053361 establish task learnability at this scale, not new-method efficacy.
